item.description:
Location: Mediterranean sea
Description:

A 3rd Engineer with COC III/1 and valid STCW certificates is needed for a bunkering tanker operating in the Mediterranean Sea. The position offers a net salary of 5500 EUR per month on a contract duration of 3 months +/-1, with joining expected in mid-October. Experience on LNG vessels is considered a significant advantage. Applicants must hold an EU passport and a valid medical certificate. Good English proficiency is required.
